subject: Dynamic Occupancy Modelling: Deriving Occupancy Estimates for Treatment AND Year?

messages.author: 16d7a0e159408512
messages.subject: Dynamic Occupancy Modelling: Deriving Occupancy Estimates for Treatment AND Year?
parts:
Hi all,

I am running a dynamic occupancy model in unmarked using the colext function. For my study, I have three treatments (bison, cattle, reference) and three seasons of data collection (2015, 2016, 2017). I am interested in deriving estimates of occupancy for each treatment AND year.

I have tried the following code as specified in Kery and Chandler 2016 (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/unmarked/vignettes/colext.pdf):

GTrt_YearWind <- nonparboot(GTrt_YearWind, B = 10)
cbind(psi="psi", smoothed=smoothed(GTrt_YearWind)[2,], SE=GTr...@smoothed.mean.bsse[2,])

Note: GTrt_YearWind is my top model, which included the following:  psi(Treatment) gamma(Year) epsilon(Year) p(Wind)

This is the output I received, which only provided occupancy estimates for each year, but not for each treatment and year:
                smoothed                                SE                  
1 "psi" 0.71759112895693        0.0921811781956899
2 "psi" 0.635347380792487     0.0839860973990768
3 "psi" 0.669231785659335     0.116188795886465 

I know I can get an estimate of occupancy for each treatment in the first year using the backTransform function, however, I am really interested in getting occupancy estimates for each treatment and each year.

Thanks so much for any advice!

Best,
Kate

parts:
Hi again, 

As an update, I found some code from a this post a few years ago, but I cannot get it to work. As a recap, I am trying to get occupancy estimates for three years (2015, 2016, and 2017) and three treatments (bison, cattle, and reference). I am currently only running models that include two treatments (bison or reference). Thus, the code I share below only includes the Bison and Reference treatments. I have been able to derive backTransformed occupancy estimates for my bison and reference treatments, but this only reflects the first year (2015). Thus, I would like to get occupancy estimates for the bison and reference site for 2016 and 2017.

I tried to extract occupancy estimates by treatment and year from the top model (Top model: GTrt_YearWind<- colext(psiformula = ~Trt, gammaformula = ~Year, epsilonformula=~Year,  pformula = ~Wind, data = GRSP, method="BFGS") and used those in the function below:
:
Treatment<-data.frame(Trt=c("0","1")) #0=reference 1=bison
Year<-data.frame(Year=c("1","2")) #Creating data frame for year
GY2 <- function(GTrt_YearWind) {
  psi1.hat <- predict(GTrt_YearWind, type="psi", newdat=Treatment)[,1]
  gamma1.hat <- predict(GTrt_YearWind, type="col",newdat=Year)[1,1] #[1,1]=First row for gamma Y1 (between 2015 and 2016)
  eps1.hat <- predict(GTrt_YearWind, type="ext",newdat=Year)[1,1]  #[1,1]=First row for epsilon Y1 (between 2015 and 2016)
  psi2.hat <- psi1.hat*(1-eps1.hat) + (1-psi1.hat)*gamma1.hat
  return(psi2.hat)
}
pbY2 <- parboot(GTrt_YearWind, statistic=GY2, nsim=1000) # GTrt_YearWind is the name of the fitted model object

Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) : 
  3 nodes produced errors; first error: object 'Treatment' not found

However, I keep receiving the error message above. Any thoughts on how to revise this? I can send data and other coding if necessary.

Thanks for any advice!

Best,
Kate
